item.title: Wilting System.
item.description:
It’s hard to understand the reaction to our system. I think one component is social media seems to pacify people. Another component is that social media has been weaponized to destroy meaning and amplify demagogues. Part of me believe that our democratic impulse has been obscured and twisted.
